self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 The Way of Sunfire: after a Charged Attack hits, a Sunfire Arrow deals 120% ATK DMG (modeled as a supplementary hit — its own rotation target (weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many times it procs; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses) and applies Heartsearer, increasing Charged Attack DMG taken by 56% for 10s. CD 10s.

en.flavor: An ancient longbow that is a remnant of King Deshret's ancient era. An indecipherable ancient text and solemn patterns have been carved into it.

refinements.1: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing <r>60%</r> ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s. Opponents affected by Heartsearer take <r>28%</r> more Charged Attack DMG from the wielder. A Sunfire Arrow can be triggered once every 10s.
refinements.2: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing <r>75%</r> ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s. Opponents affected by Heartsearer take <r>35%</r> more Charged Attack DMG from the wielder. A Sunfire Arrow can be triggered once every 10s.
refinements.3: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing <r>90%</r> ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s. Opponents affected by Heartsearer take <r>42%</r> more Charged Attack DMG from the wielder. A Sunfire Arrow can be triggered once every 10s.
refinements.4: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing <r>105%</r> ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s. Opponents affected by Heartsearer take <r>49%</r> more Charged Attack DMG from the wielder. A Sunfire Arrow can be triggered once every 10s.
refinements.5: After a Charged Attack hits an opponent, a Sunfire Arrow will descend upon the opponent hit, dealing <r>120%</r> ATK as DMG, and applying the Heartsearer effect to the opponent damaged by said Arrow for 10s. Opponents affected by Heartsearer take <r>56%</r> more Charged Attack DMG from the wielder. A Sunfire Arrow can be triggered once every 10s.

fr.flavor: Un vieil arc long qui est un vestige de l'ancienne ère du roi Deshret. Un texte ancien indéchiffrable et des motifs solennels y ont été gravés.

refinements.1: Lorsqu'une attaque chargée a touché un ennemi, une flèche solaire tombe sur ce dernier pour infliger des DGT équivalant à <r>60 %</r> de l'ATQ et appliquer pendant 10 s l'effet Brûle-cœur à l'ennemi ayant subi ses DGT. Les DGT infligés par les attaques chargées du personnage équipé de l'arme aux ennemis atteints de l'effet Brûle-cœur augmentent de <r>28 %</r>. Une flèche solaire peut être déclenchée une fois toutes les 10 s.
